name: Lean.OLeanLevel.casesOn
typeText:
{motive : Lean.OLeanLevel → Sort u} →
  (t : Lean.OLeanLevel) →
    motive Lean.OLeanLevel.exported → motive Lean.OLeanLevel.server → motive Lean.OLeanLevel.private → motive t

source.code:
/-- The level of information to save/load. Each level includes all previous ones. -/
inductive OLeanLevel where
  /-- Information from exported contexts. -/
  | exported
  /-- Environment extension state for the language server. -/
  | server
  /-- Private module data. -/
  | «private»
deriving DecidableEq, Ord, Repr
